newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait jails British businessman for forgery.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait jails British businessman for forgery.

text.p: A Kuwaiti court has sentenced a British businessman to five years in jail after convicting him of forging a signature to get 200,000 dinars ($665,000), sources close to the case said on Tuesday.
The criminal court on Monday convicted Ian Beaumont, 33, of forging the signature on a telex transfer order to obtain the money belonging to a Lebanese businessman, they added.
Beamount denies the charges and plans to appeal against the ruling, they said.
Court officials and British diplomats were not available for comment.
